transcription: You are speaking to the card services team. Before we start, can you confirm your full name? It is Daniel Morgan. My card was declined this morning when I tried to pay for petrol. Thank you, Mr Morgan. I can see a temporary block was placed on the card because of an unusual payment overseas. That was not me. I have not been abroad this year. Understood. I will cancel that card now and send a replacement. It should arrive within five working days. Will I get the money back for the overseas payment? Yes, the payment will be refunded once our fraud team has reviewed it, usually within ten days. Okay, that is a relief.
